source: the installed build: ~/lanes/qwen-image-21/vllm-omni/src/vllm_omni/entrypoints/cli/serve.py (the OmniConfig argument group `vllm serve --help` prints under --omni) plus vLLM 0.29.0's own EngineArgs for the handful of core flags that can move an image number
notes: vllm-omni is an out-of-tree addition to a stock vLLM wheel, so the version string names both: vllm 0.29.0 from the PyPI aarch64 wheel plus vllm-omni from PR 7759. That is why this is registered as a fork with source_ref at the PR head and why results carry engine.build. Two defaults are traps. --gpu-memory-utilization is accepted, echoed back in 'non-default args', and then has no effect on the diffusion path: it sizes the KV cache, and the diffusion stage loads all components resident regardless. And --diffusion-quantization-config's help text shows only the flat form; the per-component dict the model's own recipe uses is undocumented there but is detected by quantization/factory.py and confirmed in the server log. --enforce-eager defaults to false, so CUDA graph capture lands inside the first request unless the run is warmed.

params.name: served-model-name
params.help: Name the OpenAI routes answer to. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: trust-remote-code
params.help: Allow custom code from the checkpoint repo.

params.name: omni
params.help: Enable the vLLM-Omni multi-stage / diffusion path. Without it `vllm serve` is the text engine and this model does not load at all.

params.name: task-type
params.help: Model-defined startup task; diffusion models may use it to select task-specific weights.

params.name: diffusion-load-format
params.help: How the diffusion weights are read.

params.name: diffusers-load-kwargs
params.help: Extra kwargs handed to the diffusers loader.

params.name: diffusers-call-kwargs
params.help: Extra kwargs handed to the pipeline call. Anything here changes the picture.

params.name: diffusion-quantization-config
params.help: Online quantization. The help only shows the flat form {"method":"fp8","activation_scheme":"dynamic"}, but quantization/factory.py detects a per-component dict (no top-level `method` key) and the server logs 'Per-component quantization'. That per-component form, with ignored_layers, is what the model's own recipe uses.

params.name: force-cutlass-fp8
params.help: Force CUTLASS FP8 linear kernels for ModelOpt FP8 checkpoints on SM89+. Ignored for bf16 and for online (non-ModelOpt) FP8.

params.name: gpu-memory-utilization
params.help: vLLM EngineArgs. It sizes the autoregressive KV cache and DOES NOT bound the diffusion path: the diffusion stage loads every component resident and walks straight past it. There is no equivalent of SGLang's auto memory policy here — short of memory, vLLM-Omni keeps allocating rather than downgrading to offload.

params.name: enforce-eager
params.help: vLLM EngineArgs. False means CUDA graphs are captured on first use, so a cold first request carries graph capture inside its own measurement.

params.name: max-model-len
params.help: vLLM EngineArgs; the text side's context, not the latent sequence.

params.name: dtype
params.help: vLLM EngineArgs; auto reads the checkpoint's own dtype.

params.name: diffusion-attention-backend
params.help: Unset resolves from the device: on GB10 the platform default prints 'CUDNN_ATTN (Blackwell sm_121, cuDNN 92000, head_dim 128)'.

params.name: diffusion-attention-config
params.help: Per-role attention configuration, e.g. default.backend FLASH_ATTN or per_role.cross.backend SAGE_ATTN.

params.name: diffusion-compile-dynamic
params.help: Dynamic shapes for the compiled graph.

params.name: cache-backend
params.help: Step caching across denoising steps; 'none' is off, and anything else changes the picture as well as the speed.

params.name: step-execution
params.help: How a denoising step is scheduled.

params.name: vae-use-tiling
params.help: Decode the VAE in tiles. With --enforce-eager this is the vendor's memory advice; neither helps a run that dies during weight loading, which is where the bf16 attempt died on a busy box.

params.name: lora-scale
params.help: LoRA scale; distilled LoRAs are fused at their checkpoint scale.

params.name: request-batch-max-wait-ms
params.help: How long the scheduler waits to fill a batch. Irrelevant at concurrency 1.

params.name: enable-sleep-mode
params.help: GPU memory pool for sleep mode.

params.name: true-cfg-scale
params.help: Per-request. This engine's wire name for the canonical guidance parameter; SGLang-Diffusion calls the same thing guidance_scale, so raw flag values are not comparable across the two lanes — only the effective guidance is.

params.name: seed
params.help: Per-request. Seed semantics are engine-specific: at seed 42 this lane produces a different, equally valid scene from SGLang's, so a fidelity number against a bf16 bundle made elsewhere is not a quality number.

params.name: negative-prompt
params.help: Per-request; only does anything above guidance 1.

params.name: response-format
params.help: Per-request; the harness asks for b64_json.
